_meta.title: Session 31 — DeepSWE leaderboard ingest (Datacurve) + AA AAII sweep delta
_meta.context: User-requested investigation of DeepSWE leaderboard (deepswe.datacurve.ai/data) — a NEW SWE benchmark from Datacurve. 113 hand-crafted tasks across 91 repositories × 5 programming languages, contamination-free (no model encountered solutions during pretraining). Prompts shorter than competitors yet require substantially more code generation. Pass@1 ± 95% CI metric across 7,232 trials. Headline: gpt-5.5 [xhigh] leads at 70±4%, substantially outpacing other frontier models. 12 models scored. Also includes AAII delta sweep from artificialanalysis.ai/leaderboards/models — 6 under-tracked variants gain AAII scores (GLM-5-Turbo, GLM-5V-Turbo, MiMo-V2.5, MiMo-V2-Omni, MiMo-V2-Omni-0327, Tencent Hunyuan-Hy3-preview).
_meta.rule: STRICT-ATTRIBUTION. DeepSWE Pass@1 ± CI verbatim from leaderboard, including reasoning-effort suffix in notes ([xhigh]/[max]/[high]/[medium]). All 12 models already exist in DB. AAII deltas: only variants WITHOUT existing aa_intelligence_index_v3 score are filled — no overwrite of existing values.

models.name: DeepSWE (Datacurve benchmark)
models._note: Benchmark — NOT an evaluated model. Registered as meta-model so the benchmark family has provenance. Datacurve provides hand-crafted SWE tasks across 91 repos × 5 languages. 113 tasks × ~64 trials each = 7,232 trial dataset. Public leaderboard at deepswe.datacurve.ai.
